title: Hero word over a colour band, wiped on and off
summary: One frame-wide word with a white-to-blue fill rises over a glowing blue-violet-magenta band, then a short line, then a lit wordmark on black. Every element wipes on left to right, drifts left and is erased from the left.
use_when: A 4-5 s teaser or bumper: one verb, one promise line, the name
Opening a longer film with a single oversized word
Silent autoplay where three text beats must read without sound
A dark, premium brand with a cool gradient accent

look.type_style: medium geometric grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; hero word cap height ~49 % H and 84 % of width, vertical fill white top to translucent blue bottom; line ~9 % H; wordmark ~20 % H with a left-bright, right-dim horizontal fill

sfx.event: hero word and line wipe on with a left slide
wordmark lights up with a halo

structure.shot: black lead-in; the colour band starts to fade up from the bottom edge
structure.motion: band opacity 0 -> ~0.6 from f1, easings.outQuint (part of the 10 fr fade, f1-f11)

structure.shot: one-word verb filling 84 % of the width, white-to-blue vertical fill, over a blue-violet-magenta band in the lower 40 %
structure.camera: pan left: word left edge 13 % -> 7.5 % W over f8-f30 (~10 px/fr then ~2.4 px/fr at 1920), then exits off the left
structure.motion: letters revealed left to right by a feathered mask, f1-f13 (13 fr, 1 fr strip), word slides left on easings.outExpo; exit f35-f42: mask erases from the left while the word accelerates left, easings.inExpo 7 fr

structure.shot: promise line, 3 words, ~9 % H, centred, same band behind; the band dims to black at the end
structure.camera: pan left: line centre 0.61 -> 0.51 W in f42-f53, then drift 0.51 -> 0.48 W over f53-f70 (~1.9 px/fr at 1920)
structure.motion: line enters from the right with gaussian blur, blur 0 and settled by f54 (12 fr, easings.outExpo); hold f54-f70; exit f71-f81: feathered mask erases from the left, line accelerates left, easings.inExpo 10 fr; band fades to black f76-f82

structure.shot: product wordmark ~60 % W on pure black, grey with a left-bright to right-dim fill, lit once by a soft halo
structure.camera: pan left: wordmark left edge 0.67 -> 0.21 W over f83-f96 (fast, decelerating), then near static to f122
structure.motion: letters wipe on left to right f83-f90 while sliding left on easings.outExpo; light-on f96-f104 (S-curve ~8 fr), halo peaks f101-f105 then decays to grey by f115; exit f123-f129: mask erases from the left, ends on an almost black frame

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, bg (black), accent and accent2 for the band
params.content.word: one short verb or noun, 4-6 letters, fitted to ~84 % of the width
params.content.line: promise line, 3-4 words, one line at 16:9
params.content.name: product name set as the wordmark
params.band.colors: 3 stops for the lower band: deep blue, violet, magenta (defaults from the palette)
params.timing.word: frames for the hero word row (default 42)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips: every text element uses the same grammar: feathered left-to-right reveal mask that travels with the text, a decelerating slide left, a short hold with slow left drift, and an accelerating exit where the mask erases from the left edge. Hero word reveal 13 fr, exits 7-10 fr. Band disappears with the line (f76-f82) so the wordmark sits on pure black. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): travelling edge-mask reveal, gradient-filled letters, colour band (mesh-gradient limited to the lower 40 %). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
